52 def compile_utterance(text, dialogue=None):
53     """The engine's word: ``{"ok", "act", "args", "campaign", "refused"}`` or None when the engine could not answer."""
54     text = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
55     if not text:
56         return None
57     try:
58         r = subprocess.run(["node", "--input-type=module", "-e", _JS % (dialogue or DIALOGUE), "--", text],
59                            capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=30)
60         return json.loads(r.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1])
61     except Exception:
62         return None

67 def _norm(s):
68     s = " ".join(str(s or "").lower().split()).strip(" .!?,\u2019'\"")
69     return re.sub(r"^(?:the|an|a) ", "", s)

72 def _find(cands, phrase, what):
73     """``cands`` = [(id, name, ...)]; the exact name or id, else the one candidate containing the words either way."""
74     key = _norm(phrase)
75     if not key:
76         return None, "which %s? say its name" % what
77     exact = [c for c in cands if _norm(c[1]) == key or _norm(c[0]) == key]
78     if len(exact) == 1:
79         return exact[0], None
80     words = {w for w in re.split(r"[^a-z0-9]+", key) if w and w not in _STOP}
81     byword = [c for c in cands if words and words <= {w for w in re.split(r"[^a-z0-9]+", _norm(c[1])) if w}]
82     if len(byword) == 1:
83         return byword[0], None
84     # a looser match (the words inside a name) only NAMES a candidate; it never selects one, so it never writes
85     near = byword or [c for c in cands if key in _norm(c[1])]
86     if len(near) == 1:
87         return None, "did you mean \u2018%s\u2019? say its name" % near[0][1]
88     if near or exact:
89         names = " or ".join("\u2018%s\u2019" % c[1] for c in (exact or near)[:5])
90         return None, "\u2018%s\u2019 could be %s \u2014 say which" % (phrase, names)
91     names = ", ".join("\u2018%s\u2019" % c[1] for c in cands[:6])
92     return None, "no %s named \u2018%s\u2019%s" % (what, phrase, (" \u2014 the record has " + names) if names else "")

95 _MONTHS = {m.lower(): k for k, m in enumerate(_cal.month_abbr) if m}
96 _MONTHS.update({m.lower(): k for k, m in enumerate(_cal.month_name) if m})
97 _DAYS = {d.lower(): k for k, d in enumerate(_cal.day_abbr)}
98 _DAYS.update({d.lower(): k for k, d in enumerate(_cal.day_name)})

101 def parse_due(s, today=None):
102     """YYYY-MM-DD · today · tomorrow · Tuesday · Oct 27 · 27 Oct (this year, as typed) — or None when the calendar has
103     no such day (the same rule the Desk's own editor keeps)."""
104     today = today or date.today()
105     s = " ".join(str(s or "").lower().split()).strip(" .!")
106     if not s:
107         return None
108     m = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})", s)
109     if m:
110         try:
111             return date(int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))).isoformat()
112         except ValueError:
113             return None
114     if s == "today":
115         return today.isoformat()
116     if s == "tomorrow":
117         return (today + timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()
118     if s.isalpha() and (s in _DAYS or s[:3] in _DAYS):
119         ahead = (_DAYS.get(s, _DAYS.get(s[:3])) - today.weekday()) % 7 or 7
120         return (today + timedelta(days=ahead)).isoformat()
121     m = re.fullmatch(r"([a-z]+)\.? (\d{1,2})", s) or re.fullmatch(r"(\d{1,2}) ([a-z]+)\.?", s)
122     if m:
123         a, b = m.group(1), m.group(2)
124         mon, day = (a, b) if a.isalpha() else (b, a)
125         k = _MONTHS.get(mon) or _MONTHS.get(mon[:3])
126         if k:
127             try:
128                 return date(today.year, k, int(day)).isoformat()
129             except ValueError:
130                 return None
131     return None

136 def _answer(r, act):
137     out = {"ok": bool(r.get("ok")), "say": r.get("receipt") or "", "receipt": r.get("receipt") or "", "undo": r.get("undo"),
138            "act": act, "campaign_act": True, "model_called": False}
139     if r.get("step"):
140         out["step"] = r["step"]
141     return out

148 def _needs(folder, span, today):
149     """What needs him: the parts flagged needs-you, and the dated parts inside the span — read from the record."""
150     try:
151         import high_seat_page as _hsp
152         from .campaign_parts import resolve_parts
153         from .steward_campaign import read_map
154         steps = (read_map(str(folder)) or {}).get("steps") or []
155         inits = _hsp.campaign_initiatives(steps, resolve_parts(steps, cache={}, with_lead=False))
156     except Exception as e:
157         return _refuse("the Campaign record could not be read: %s" % e, "campaign_needs")
158     needs = [(p, i) for i in inits for p in i["needs"]]
159     monday = today - timedelta(days=today.weekday())
160     start = monday.isoformat() if span != "today" else ""
161     end = today if span == "today" else monday + timedelta(days=6)
162     dated = sorted(((p["date"], p, i) for i in inits for p in i["parts"]
163                     if p["date"] and not p["broken"] and p["status"] not in ("done", "parked") and start <= p["date"] <= end.isoformat()), key=lambda x: x[0])
164 
165     def more(n):
166         return (" \u2014 and %d more" % (n - 5)) if n > 5 else ""
167     bits = []
168     if needs:
169         bits.append("%d need%s your word: %s%s" % (len(needs), "s" if len(needs) == 1 else "", "; ".join("%s (%s, tier %s)" % (p["text"], i["name"], i["tier"] or "?") for p, i in needs[:5]), more(len(needs))))
170     else:
171         bits.append("nothing waits on your word")
172     label = "today" if span == "today" else "this week"
173     if dated:
174         bits.append("dated %s: %s%s" % ("today or earlier" if span == "today" else "inside this week (Monday to Sunday)", "; ".join("%s (%s, %s)" % (p["text"], i["name"], p["date"]) for d, p, i in dated[:5]), more(len(dated))))
175     else:
176         bits.append("nothing on the Campaign is dated %s" % ("today or earlier" if span == "today" else "inside this week"))
177     return {"ok": True, "say": "; ".join(bits) + ".", "receipt": "", "undo": None, "act": "campaign_needs", "campaign_act": True, "read_only": True, "model_called": False}

183 def _bare_pace(folder, text, today):
184     """"<name> by <date>" (fit 5) is a pace only when the left side is exactly one initiative: the whole name, or the
185     start of exactly one name ("MBA" for "MBA Teaching, Fall 2026"; "the trusts" for "The trusts and the holding
186     company"). An interior word ("teaching by Monday") names nothing here and the words go to the steward. The
187     engine's grammar does not carry this form (Grok W1): the names live here, so the reading does too."""
188     m = _BARE_BY.match(" ".join(str(text or "").split()))
189     if not m:
190         return None
191     from . import campaign_acts as acts
192     inits = [(s["id"], s.get("name") or s["id"]) for s, g in acts._initiatives(folder)]
193     key = _norm(m.group(1))
194     if not key:
195         return None
196     hits = [c for c in inits if _norm(c[1]) == key or _norm(c[0]) == key]
197     if not hits:
198         hits = [c for c in inits if _norm(c[1]).startswith(key + " ") or _norm(c[1]).startswith(key + ",")]
199     if len(hits) != 1:
200         return None
201     when = parse_due(m.group(2), today)
202     if when is None:
203         return None      # "<name> by <not a date>" is not a pace: the steward takes the words
204     return _answer(acts.pace(folder, hits[0][0], when), "campaign_pace")

209     ("campaign_pace", re.compile(r"^(?:(?:set )?(?:the )?pace(?: (?:to|by|at|is|of))?|by|due|finish(?:ed)? by|done by)\s+(.+?)\s*[.!]?$", re.I)),
210     ("campaign_pace_clear", re.compile(r"^(?:clear|drop|remove) the pace\s*[.!]?$|^no pace\s*[.!]?$", re.I)),
211     ("campaign_goal_seat", re.compile(r"^(?:make (?:it|this) active|activate(?: it| this)?|put (?:it|this) on deck|bench(?: it| this)?|send (?:it|this) back)\s*[.!]?$", re.I)),
212     ("campaign_activate", re.compile(r"^(?:make|set) (.+?) active\s*[.!]?$|^activate (.+?)\s*[.!]?$", re.I)),
213     ("campaign_deck", re.compile(r"^put (.+?) on deck\s*[.!]?$|^deck (.+?)\s*[.!]?$", re.I)),
214     ("campaign_home", re.compile(r"^send (.+?) (?:back|home)(?: to (?:its|the) goal)?\s*[.!]?$|^put (.+?) back(?: in (?:its|the) goal)?\s*[.!]?$|^bench (.+?)\s*[.!]?$", re.I)),
215     ("campaign_move_tier", re.compile(r"^(?:(?:move|put) (?:it |this )?(?:to |in |into )?)?tier ([123])\s*[.!]?$", re.I)),
216     ("campaign_done_when", re.compile(r"^(?:the )?(?:goal|done when|done looks like|done is|done means)(?: is)?:?\s+(.+?)\s*[.!]?$", re.I)),
217     # the Star Chart (2026-10-03): "if-then: if it is Monday 9:00, then I send the trust questions" - his words, kept whole
218     ("campaign_if_then", re.compile(r"^(?:the )?(?:if[- ]then|next step)(?: is)?:\s*(.+?)\s*$", re.I)),

222 def _scoped(folder, goal, text, today):
223     """Inside a goal's place (W2 v2) a verb needs no name: "add a part: …", "pace by Oct 10", "make it active",
224     "bench it", "tier 2", "goal: …". None when the words are none of these (the general grammar, then the steward,
225     take them — told which goal he is in)."""
226     from . import campaign_acts as acts
227     s = acts._step(folder, goal)
228     if s is None or acts._own_group(s) is None:
229         return None
230     t = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
231     for act, rx in _SCOPED:
232         m = rx.match(t)
233         if not m:
234             continue
235         if act == "campaign_add_part":
236             due = None
237             if m.group(2):
238                 due = parse_due(m.group(2), today)
239                 if due is None:
240                     return _refuse("I could not read \u2018%s\u2019 as a date \u2014 Oct 10, Tuesday or 2026-10-10; nothing was added" % m.group(2), act)
241             return _answer(acts.add(folder, goal, "task", m.group(1), due=due), act)
242         if act == "campaign_pace":
243             when = parse_due(m.group(1), today)
244             if when is None:
245                 return None      # "by the end of the world": not a date — the steward takes the words
246             return _answer(acts.pace(folder, goal, when), act)
247         if act == "campaign_pace_clear":
248             return _answer(acts.pace(folder, goal, "none"), "campaign_pace")
249         if act == "campaign_goal_seat":
250             return _answer(acts.seat(folder, goal, "active"), "campaign_activate")      # refused by the writer: a goal has no seat — it names the components
251         if act in ("campaign_activate", "campaign_deck", "campaign_home"):
252             name = next((x for x in m.groups() if x), "")
253             mine = [(p["id"], p.get("name") or p["id"]) for p in acts._parts_of(folder, goal) if acts._kind_of(p) in acts.INITIATIVE_KINDS]
254             hit, why = _find(mine, name, "component")
255             if hit is None:
256                 return None      # not one of this goal's components: the general grammar reads the name across the record
257             return _answer(acts.home(folder, hit[0]) if act == "campaign_home" else acts.seat(folder, hit[0], "active" if act == "campaign_activate" else "deck"), act)
258         if act == "campaign_move_tier":
259             return _answer(acts.move_tier(folder, goal, int(m.group(1))), act)
260         if act == "campaign_done_when":
261             return _answer(acts.done_when(folder, goal, m.group(1)), act)
262         if act == "campaign_if_then":
263             return _answer(acts.if_then(folder, goal, m.group(1)), act)
264     return None

267 def say_campaign(folder, text, dialogue=None, today=None, goal=None):
268     """None when the words are not a Campaign verb (the steward takes them); else the act's answer. With ``goal``
269     (an initiative id: the words were said inside that goal's place) the scoped forms are read first."""
270     if goal:
271         scoped = _scoped(folder, str(goal), text, today or date.today())
272         if scoped is not None:
273             return scoped
274     bare = _bare_pace(folder, text, today or date.today())
275     if bare is not None:
276         return bare
277     c = compile_utterance(text, dialogue)
278     if c is None:
279         return _refuse("the Campaign\u2019s grammar could not be read (the engine did not answer) \u2014 nothing was done", "campaign_compile")
280     if not c.get("campaign"):
281         return None
282     try:
283         return _apply(folder, c, today or date.today())
284     except Exception as e:
285         return _refuse("that did not go through: %s \u2014 look at the board before saying it again" % e, str(c.get("act") or "campaign_act"))
286

288 def _apply(folder, c, today):
289     from . import campaign_acts as acts
290     act, a = c["act"], c.get("args") or {}
291     inits = [(s["id"], s.get("name") or s["id"]) for s, g in acts._initiatives(folder)]
292     heads = {i for i, _ in inits}
293     parts = [(p["id"], p.get("name") or p["id"]) for p in acts._projection(folder)
294              if p.get("id") not in heads and isinstance(p.get("navigation"), dict) and (p["navigation"].get("path") or [])]
295     if act == "campaign_move_tier":
296         hit, why = _find(inits, a.get("initiative"), "goal")
297         return _refuse(why, act) if hit is None else _answer(acts.move_tier(folder, hit[0], a.get("tier")), act)
298     if act == "campaign_add_part":
299         hit, why = _find(inits, a.get("initiative"), "goal")
300         if hit is None:
301             return _refuse(why, act)
302         due = None
303         if a.get("due"):
304             due = parse_due(a["due"], today)
305             if due is None:
306                 return _refuse("I could not read \u2018%s\u2019 as a date \u2014 Oct 3, Tuesday, today or 2026-10-03; nothing was added" % a["due"], act)
307         return _answer(acts.add(folder, hit[0], "task", a.get("text"), due), act)
308     if act == "campaign_promote_seed":
309         from .campaign_seeds import read_seeds
310         seeds = [(s["id"], s["text"]) for s in read_seeds(folder)]
311         hit, why = _find(seeds, a.get("seed"), "seed")
312         if hit is None:
313             if not str(why or "").startswith("no seed"):
314                 return _refuse(why, act)      # a near seed ("did you mean") or a tie is answered; nothing is written (Grok's read of W2b)
315             # no seed by that name: a goal from his words (2026-09-30), at the tier and area he said
316             return _answer(acts.new_goal(folder, a.get("seed"), a.get("tier"), a.get("area")), act)
317         area = str(a.get("area") or "").lower() or None
318         if area and area not in AREAS:
319             return _refuse("the life areas are %s \u2014 which?" % ", ".join(AREAS), act)
320         return _answer(acts.promote(folder, hit[0], a.get("tier") or 3, area), act)
321     if act == "campaign_park":
322         hit, why = _find(parts, a.get("part"), "part")
323         if hit is None:
324             return _refuse(why, act)
325         if not a.get("trigger"):
326             return _refuse("a park carries its trigger \u2014 say \u2018park %s until January\u2019, or what it waits for" % hit[1], act)
327         return _answer(acts.park(folder, hit[0], a["trigger"]), act)
328     if act == "campaign_unpark":
329         hit, why = _find(parts, a.get("part"), "part")
330         return _refuse(why, act) if hit is None else _answer(acts.unpark(folder, hit[0]), act)
331     if act == "campaign_needs":
332         return _needs(folder, a.get("span") or "week", today)
333     # the seats (2026-09-30, his three levels): the verbs name a COMPONENT — a cockpit, an effort or a desk item
334     comps = [(p["id"], p.get("name") or p["id"]) for p in acts._projection(folder)
335              if p.get("id") not in heads and isinstance(p.get("navigation"), dict) and (p["navigation"].get("path") or []) and acts._kind_of(p) in acts.INITIATIVE_KINDS]
336     if act in ("campaign_activate", "campaign_deck", "campaign_home"):
337         key = _norm(a.get("initiative"))
338         g = next((c for c in inits if key and (_norm(c[1]) == key or _norm(c[0]) == key)), None)
339         if g is not None:      # he named a goal by its whole name: a goal has no seat — the writer's refusal names its components
340             return _answer(acts.seat(folder, g[0], "active"), act)
341         if key and not any(_norm(c[1]) == key or _norm(c[0]) == key for c in comps):
342             # the start of exactly one goal's name (the pace rule: "the trusts") is that goal, whatever its id — a
343             # goal has no seat; words that are one component's words still seat the component (Grok's read of W2b)
344             pre = [c for c in inits if _norm(c[1]).startswith(key + " ") or _norm(c[1]).startswith(key + ",")]
345             if len(pre) == 1:
346                 return _answer(acts.seat(folder, pre[0][0], "active"), act)
347         hit, why = _find(comps, a.get("initiative"), "initiative")
348         if hit is None:
349             return _refuse(why, act)
350         return _answer(acts.home(folder, hit[0]) if act == "campaign_home" else acts.seat(folder, hit[0], "active" if act == "campaign_activate" else "deck"), act)
351     if act == "campaign_pace":
352         hit, why = _find(inits, a.get("initiative"), "goal")
353         if hit is None:
354             return _refuse(why, act)      # an explicit pace verb that names no initiative is refused with the names
355         when = parse_due(a.get("pace"), today) if a.get("pace") not in (None, "", "none") else "none"
356         if when is None:
357             return _refuse("I could not read \u2018%s\u2019 as a date \u2014 Oct 10, Tuesday or 2026-10-10; the pace is unchanged" % a.get("pace"), act)
358         return _answer(acts.pace(folder, hit[0], when), act)
359     return None
